title: Sets of subspaces with restricted hyperplane intersection numbers
summary: Let $\mathcal{X}$ be a set of $(h-1)$-dimensional subspaces of $\mathrm{PG}(kh-1,q)$ with the property that every hyperplane contains at most $t$ elements of $\mathcal{X}$. We prove the upper bound $|\mathcal{X}| \leq (t-k+2)q^h + t$, and characterise the structure of $\mathcal{X}$ in the case of equality. We call spanning sets attaining this bound \emph{length-maximal}.
